breaking: No new database file. Schedules are now on by default for a fresh install, but an rc.9 keeper.json written by the old installer says schedulesLive: false and an installer re-run keeps that value, so on an rc.9 server set it to true once by hand.

Re-run the installer after the update so the keeper settings gain publicDoorOrigin and the owner time zone in each role's default binding; then apply each agent once so its container gets OWNER_HOME_TZ (and the deadline calendar mount, when that file exists). Agents with their own binding do not get OWNER_HOME_TZ from the installer.

The nightly backup now also encrypts /srv/lares/secrets into the bundle, and the backup scripts read /etc/lares/backup.env when it exists. Snapshots taken before this release have no token folder; the first nightly backup after updating adds it.
